questionAudits.original: According to the producer, the live interview is scheduled to begin at noon.

questionAudits.original: It is very unlikely that the backup recording will be usable.
questionAudits.target: There ____ the backup recording being usable.
completedSentences: There is very little chance of the backup recording being usable.
There is little chance of the backup recording being usable.
questionAudits.rationale: there is very little chance of与is little chance of均表达备用录音可用性很低，of后保留being usable。chance在此不可数，用little而非few。

questionAudits.original: The announcer said that she had not altered the script.
questionAudits.target: The announcer ____ any changes to the script.
completedSentences: The announcer denied having made any changes to the script.
questionAudits.rationale: denied having made any changes把原来明确说自己没有改稿转为否认作过更改，保留已发生的说话及其否定内容。deny后用动名词，不接to have made。

questionAudits.original: As soon as the bulletin ended, the phone rang.
questionAudits.target: No ____ than the phone rang.
completedSentences: No sooner had the bulletin ended than the phone rang.
No sooner did the bulletin end than the phone rang.
questionAudits.rationale: No sooner had the bulletin ended than或No sooner did the bulletin end than均表达播报结束电话随即响起。had后要ended；did后才用end，不能混搭had end。

questionAudits.original: Staff must never reveal callers’ phone numbers.
questionAudits.target: Staff must ____ callers’ phone numbers.
completedSentences: Staff must under no circumstances reveal callers’ phone numbers.
questionAudits.rationale: must under no circumstances reveal保留对员工任何情况下均不得透露号码的强禁止，关键词UNDER在空内独立保留。must后核心动词须reveal原形，不用revealing。

questionAudits.original: We almost reached the minimum number of participants, but not quite.
questionAudits.target: We ____ the minimum number of participants.
completedSentences: We fell just short of the minimum number of participants.
We fell only just short of the minimum number of participants.
questionAudits.rationale: fell just short of及only just变体表示差一点达到最低人数，保留未真正达标。of后若另接动词应为动名词；of reach形态错误且破坏此名词补语。

questionAudits.original: The application will probably be approved next week.
questionAudits.target: The application ____ next week.
completedSentences: The application is likely to be approved next week.
The application will likely be approved next week.
questionAudits.rationale: is likely to be approved或will likely be approved均保留申请下周大概获批这一未来被动预测，不将概率改成确定。to后接be原形，再接approved，不能用to being。

questionAudits.original: The survey’s cancellation was entirely caused by insufficient funding.
questionAudits.target: Insufficient funding ____ the survey’s cancellation.
completedSentences: Insufficient funding accounted entirely for the survey’s cancellation.
Insufficient funding accounted wholly for the survey’s cancellation.
Insufficient funding entirely accounted for the survey’s cancellation.
Insufficient funding wholly accounted for the survey’s cancellation.
questionAudits.rationale: accounted entirely for或wholly for以及副词置于accounted前的变体均说明资金不足完全解释并导致取消，保留唯一原因及过去事件。表示解释原因的account for不能换成account to。

questionAudits.original: Neither researcher was responsible for losing the consent forms.
questionAudits.target: Neither researcher ____ losing the consent forms.
completedSentences: Neither researcher was to blame for losing the consent forms.
questionAudits.rationale: was to blame for保留两位研究者均不应为丢失同意书负责，Neither的否定作用不变。to blame for是此处责任搭配，不用of。

We were forced to resort to recruiting through a second clinic.
questionAudits.rationale: had to resort to recruiting或were forced to resort to recruiting均表示不得不改由第二诊所招募，不添自愿意味。resort to的to是介词，后接recruiting而非recruit。

questionAudits.original: No visitor has complained about the new benches.

questionAudits.original: I would choose the sheltered path rather than the exposed ridge.

questionAudits.original: It makes no difference to the price whether you pay in cash or by card.

questionAudits.original: Although the counter is being cleaned, customers are still queuing.
